# Flisk Skills

> Portable Agent Skills (`SKILL.md`) and `AGENTS.md` rule templates for working with the Flisk CLI: a local-only, Docker + Tilt development tool. Not a deployment tool; do not invent Kubernetes or Docker Compose for Flisk projects.

Run `flisk doctor`, then `flisk up`, from the project root. One maintained copy of each skill lives under `skills/`; the Claude plugin and `.agents/skills/` are symlinks to it.

## Skills

- [flisk-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-doctor/SKILL.md): check or repair the machine and project before `flisk up` (`--all`, `--json`, `--fix`)
- [flisk-troubleshoot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-troubleshoot/SKILL.md): diagnose a stack that started and then failed: red Tilt resources, crash loops, unhealthy services, an overloaded machine
- [flisk-scaffold](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-scaffold/SKILL.md): start a project (blank or from a starter or example) and add new services with `flisk resource`
- [flisk-build-runtimes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-build-runtimes/SKILL.md): pick the language or framework of a new service (Bun, Python, Go, Rust, Node; React, Vue, Next.js and more)
- [flisk-frontend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-frontend/SKILL.md): add a web app to a stack and work with its generated nginx, Vite and API client files
- [flisk-agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-agents/SKILL.md): build and operate AI agent resources: the session contract, checkpoints and `flisk agent sessions`
- [flisk-demo-bubbles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-demo-bubbles/SKILL.md): hand out a personalised demo.flisk.sh stack for a person (link, JSON API or the `make_demo` MCP tool)
- [flisk-unfollowers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-unfollowers/SKILL.md): who unfollowed an X account in a 10m, 1h or 1d window (`get_unfollowers` MCP tool)
- [flisk-byo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-byo/SKILL.md): bring an existing Dockerfile, image or one-shot job into a stack as a bring-your-own resource
- [flisk-import-compose](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-import-compose/SKILL.md): import a root `docker-compose.yml` with `flisk import`
- [flisk-import-procfile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-import-procfile/SKILL.md): turn Procfile processes into bring-your-own resources
- [flisk-service-json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-service-json/SKILL.md): edit and validate an existing service's `service.json`
- [flisk-generated-files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-generated-files/SKILL.md): who owns `.autogenerated/`, drift checks and regeneration
- [flisk-databases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-databases/SKILL.md): give a service a database and migrations (Prisma, Drizzle, Atlas, Dbmate and others)
- [flisk-data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-data/SKILL.md): reset, seed, snapshot and restore local Postgres data
- [flisk-secrets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-secrets/SKILL.md): `params`, secrets, the project `.env` and `flisk up --env-file`
- [flisk-ports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-ports/SKILL.md): routed URLs (`flisk networks`), Traefik, host ports and their overrides
- [flisk-dry-run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-dry-run/SKILL.md): preview `flisk up`, `down`, `import`, `doctor --fix` and `upgrade --all` without changing anything
- [flisk-ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-ui/SKILL.md): the interactive terminal dashboard (`flisk ui`)
- [flisk-upgrade](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-upgrade/SKILL.md): upgrade the CLI and keep a team on `minFliskVersion`
- [flisk-layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-layout/SKILL.md): where the project lives when services span several repos or teams
- [flisk-starlark-perf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-starlark-perf/SKILL.md): make discovery, Tiltfile evaluation and golden builds faster
- [flisk-benchmark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-benchmark/SKILL.md): measure memory per service, start times and how many services fit on a machine
- [flisk-helm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-helm/SKILL.md): keep Helm, Argo CD, Flux or Kustomize for production next to Flisk locally
- [flisk-deploy-aws](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-aws/SKILL.md): ship a working stack to AWS (ECS/Fargate, EKS, App Runner, Lambda, EC2)
- [flisk-deploy-azure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-azure/SKILL.md): ship a working stack to Azure (Container Apps, AKS, App Service, Functions)
- [flisk-deploy-gcp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-gcp/SKILL.md): ship a working stack to Google Cloud (Cloud Run, GKE, App Engine, Compute Engine)
- [flisk-deploy-digitalocean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-digitalocean/SKILL.md): ship a working stack to DigitalOcean (App Platform, Droplets, Kubernetes)
- [flisk-deploy-cloudflare](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-cloudflare/SKILL.md): ship a frontend or compatible service to Cloudflare (Pages, Workers)
- [flisk-deploy-vercel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-vercel/SKILL.md): ship a frontend or serverless functions to Vercel
- [flisk-deploy-fly](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-fly/SKILL.md): ship a working stack to Fly.io
- [flisk-deploy-heroku](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-heroku/SKILL.md): ship a working stack to Heroku
- [flisk-deploy-railway](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-railway/SKILL.md): ship a working stack to Railway
- [flisk-deploy-render](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-deploy-render/SKILL.md): ship a working stack to Render
- [flisk-contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/flisk-contributing/SKILL.md): contribute to the flisk CLI repository itself
- [layer-autoresearch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/skills/layer-autoresearch/SKILL.md): contributor experiment loop that optimises the L1-L4 Docker layers (keep/discard)

## Rules templates

- [AGENTS.landscape.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/rules/AGENTS.landscape.md): for Flisk project, example and starter repos
- [AGENTS.cli-core.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/main/rules/AGENTS.cli-core.md): for contributors to flisk

## Install

- [README](https://github.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/blob/main/README.md): `npx skills add flisk-sh/flisk-skills`, or `install.sh --agent claude|codex|opencode|cursor|agents`
- [SPEC](https://github.com/flisk-sh/flisk-skills/blob/main/SPEC.md): layout and discovery paths

## Related

- [Flisk docs](https://flisk.sh/docs/quickstart/): quick start and configuration
- [Flisk llms.txt](https://flisk.sh/llms.txt): index of the Flisk site, docs and reference landscapes
- [flisk](https://github.com/flisk-sh/flisk): the CLI source and `cli/README.md` command reference
